name: POST to Rayvn log
info:
Posts a bridged entry to the Rayvn log API.

### Input
`msg.payload` = Rayvn POST body, `msg.metadata.target` = Rayvn Client

### Logic
Sets `Authorization: Bearer {api_key}`, URL `/logs/{log_id}/entry`, sends POST. 500ms delay between requests.

### Output
`msg.topic = "response"`, `msg.result = true/false`, `msg.statusCode`

name: POST To Rayvn Entry Point
info: Sends the message to Rayvn log API with POST request. This is the step that delivers the WaSOS message into the Rayvn log.

name: Format header and url
info: Builds HTTP request headers and URL for Rayvn API. Sets Authorization header with Bearer token from rayvnConfig.apiKey and constructs URL to /logs/{logId}/entry endpoint. Returns null if not configured.
